analysis.title: AMP'ed — Alternative Energy Weekly (SEDG, BE, PLUG, BLDP, FCEL, DUK, NEE, AEP, Amazon, X-Energy, Google)
key_insights: The administration issued a proclamation under Section 232 declaring wind turbine and component imports a potential national security threat, citing cybersecurity, radar and air traffic interference, and import reliance. It imposes no new tariffs now. Trade officials are directed to negotiate with partners and report back within 180 days, with potential tariffs still under consideration.

GOOG and Voltus agreed to develop a 1 GW virtual power plant in PJM. GOOG funds the capacity and Voltus dispatches batteries, thermostats, distributed generation and demand response during grid stress. It expands a 100 MW three-year deal signed in June and extends the commitment through 2040, ramping over three to four years. North America has about 2,000 VPPs totaling about 37.5 GW.
SEDG's Nexis IslandDER meter collar was approved in PG&E and SDG&E territories. PG&E has approved four meter socket adapter solutions and SDG&E five. SCE witness testing is scheduled to complete.

NMED scheduled a December 7 hearing on the air permit for BE's Project Jupiter 2.45 GW microgrid. Updated technical modeling showed about a 2% increase in estimated emissions but roughly doubled modeled ambient pollutant concentrations. ORCL and YGI proposed an enforceable cap on fuel-cell output expected to cut permitted emissions by about 35% while keeping DC IT capacity and the 2.45 GW of BE capacity. Construction cannot proceed until the permit is issued.

PLUG appointed Dr. Lee Sweetland, a former BLDP COO with eight years at BLDP, as Global Engineering Industrialization Lead. He will focus on PEM stack manufacturing scale, reliability and cost reduction.

FCEL's Block System received a ~99.9% unit-specific ELCC rating from PJM for the 2028/29 RBP process. PJM's preliminary class ratings are 96% for nuclear, 93% for diesel/engine backup and 67% for gas turbines. KeyBanc believes the project evaluated could be the Fit Energy data center campus in Luzerne County, PA, but FCEL did not disclose it.

DUK completed the 74.9 MW Bailey Mill solar site in FL, its fifth solar site completed since 2025. DUK has more than 25 solar facilities totaling about 1,850 MW and plans 11 more by the end of 2028 and more than 5,500 MW of utility-scale solar by 2033.

NEE subsidiary received CO State Board of Land Commissioners approval for a land use lease on the 120 MW Mirasol Solar Project. It is authorized for up to 200 MW of solar and 200 MW of battery storage, with commercial operation expected in late 2028.

The administration asked a federal court to remand approval of Avangrid's 1.8 GW New England Wind project to the Interior Department. New England Wind 1 is 791 MW with a Massachusetts offtake agreement and New England Wind 2 is 1,000 MW with no offtaker. This follows similar actions on the 704 MW Revolution Wind and U.S. Wind's Maryland project.

Interior asked a federal court to remand approval of the 2.2 GW Maryland Offshore Wind Construction and Operations Plan, citing possible noncompliance with the Outer Continental Shelf Lands Act. The project includes the 300 MW Marwin and 800 MW Momentum phases, both awarded ORECs, and is delayed by legal disputes and federal policies.

TransAlta closed the sale of a 49% interest in a 500 MW Oklahoma wind portfolio to Ares for $305M. The three projects have long-term contracts with investment-grade counterparties and PTCs expiring in 2034.

X-energy and AEP signed a JDA for feasibility work on a 960 MW project of twelve 80 MW Xe-100 SMRs at AEP's former Breed Generating Station site in Sullivan County, IN. AMZN provides milestone-based development funding and is a conditional off-taker. It is the second commercial deployment under the XE and AMZN collaboration targeting more than 5 GW by 2039, and XE's third announced U.S. and fourth global project, supporting a ~11.5 GW pipeline.

The Nuclear Company proposed Prosperity One, a 6.6 GW campus of up to six Westinghouse AP1000 reactors in Lewis County, KY. Construction is targeted for 2028 subject to approvals, and it would be the largest nuclear campus in the U.S.

BE reported another strong quarter and guided higher for the rest of the year. Management sees broader customer demand, including utilities adding fuel cells to integrated resource plans. KeyBanc reports on BLDP's Ballard Forum that the shift to an integrated equipment-as-a-service model makes sense, but growth and profitability targets are ambitious, and it adjusted estimates.

market_movers.rationale: NXT is the only covered name with an Overweight in the comp sheet, with a $164 target against a $78.89 price. It reports 3Q26 on 10/28 at 5:00 PM ET.
ENPH reports 3Q26 earnings on 10/27 at 4:30 PM ET. Price is $31.60 with a $4.1B market cap.
FSLR reports 3Q26 earnings on 10/29 at 4:30 PM ET. Price is $171.99 with a $18.4B market cap.
Nexis IslandDER approvals from PG&E and SDG&E expand residential deployment opportunities in two large CA utility territories.
BE reported another strong quarter and guided higher. The Project Jupiter air permit hearing on December 7 gates construction of the 2.45 GW microgrid.
The Block System received a ~99.9% PJM ELCC rating for 2028/29, versus preliminary class ratings of 96% nuclear, 93% diesel and 67% gas turbines.
Hired the former BLDP COO to lead engineering industrialization, focused on PEM stack manufacturing scale, reliability and cost.

Management outlined a medium-term framework after the GeoPura acquisition. KeyBanc finds the move to an integrated EaaS model sensible but the growth and profitability targets ambitious, and adjusted estimates.

sector_views.rationale: Most covered names are rated Sector Weight, with NXT the only Overweight in the comp sheet.
BE, FCEL, PLUG and BLDP are all Sector Weight, while the notes on BE and FCEL describe operational and permitting progress.
The administration is seeking remand of permits for New England Wind and Maryland Offshore Wind, following Revolution Wind.

earnings_insights: ENPH reports 3Q26 earnings 10/27/2026 at 4:30 PM ET, NXT on 10/28 at 5:00 PM ET and FSLR on 10/29 at 4:30 PM ET. No estimates are given.
BE already reported 3Q26 results the prior week. KeyBanc says it was another strong quarter with guidance raised for the balance of the year. No EPS or revenue figures are given in this note.
risk_factors: BE's Project Jupiter cannot be built until the NMED air permit is issued, and the December 7 hearing follows modeling that roughly doubled ambient pollutant concentrations.
Potential tariffs on wind turbines after the 180-day Section 232 negotiation period.
Offshore wind permits face remand in federal court, and New England Wind 2 has no offtaker.
BLDP's growth and profitability targets are described as ambitious, and H2 supply infrastructure is still early.
charts_described: Figure 3 plots 2026 YTD stock performance, with BE at +151% and FCEL at +58% at the top and ARRY at -64%, CSIQ at -61% and RUN at -58% at the bottom, against SPX at +7%.
geopolitical: The administration's Section 232 proclamation on wind turbine imports directs trade negotiations with a 180-day report-back, with potential tariffs still under consideration.
The administration is asking federal courts to remand offshore wind permits for New England Wind, Maryland Offshore Wind and, earlier, Revolution Wind.
